description: Use when you need the daily dividend-adjusted total returns of one US stock or ETF over 1-15 years. Not for returns split into factor and residual parts (use riskmodels_get_return_attribution) or residual returns at the recommended hedge depth (use riskmodels_get_residual_returns). Returns, from GET /ticker-returns, the daily return series (decimal, 0.01 = 1%) with each day's L3 market, sector and subsector hedge ratios and explained-risk shares; history is point-in-time. End-of-day data, refreshed after each US market close. Price: $0.02 per call plus $0.01 per year of history beyond the first.

ticker.description: US stock ticker symbol, case-insensitive, e.g. AAPL

years.description: Years of daily history, integer 1-15, e.g. 3 (default 1)

name: riskmodels_get_returns
title: RiskModels Stock Total Returns
